name: OMNI404
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the DeFiHackLabs root-cause title.
rootCause: ERC-404 dual ID/amount transfer interpretation drains pool WETH. Lost: 2.427 WETH (run() leg reproduced here; ~3.02 ETH across the full 4-tx block)

descriptions.text: ERC-404 dual ID/amount transfer interpretation drains pool WETH. Lost: 2.427 WETH (run() leg reproduced here; ~3.02 ETH across the full 4-tx block)

Ethereum ERC-404 token OMNI404 (O404) derived NFT mint/burn counts from integer balanceOf/units diffs in _transfer(). Its transfer() treated values ≤50 as ERC-721 IDs but still moved a fixed 1e18 units. Using flash loans and Uniswap V3 exact-output swaps (transfer(recipient, 1/2/.../21)), the attacker received full-unit tokens while the pool booked wei-level amounts, draining about 2.4 WETH.
